summary: Made and shipped long video L-20261018-01, 'Repo rate hiked: the quiet way your home loan gets longer' (4:09, 55 beats, 6 chapters), from Scout's high-priority repo-hike topic.
why: 0 of 2 long videos this week; the top usable feed topic was the RBI repo hike (priority high, expires 1 Nov). Fact review passed on the second try, and QA passed on the first re-render (liveliness 1.87, layout clean, audio peak -1.0 dB).

findings.title: Fact review failed once
findings.detail: Priya's line 'They did not need to ask' contradicted RBI's Aug 2023 reset circular (borrowers must be offered EMI vs tenure). Rewritten; 'this month' changed to 'In October'; steps reframed as Rohan's plan.

findings.title: QA failed the first render
findings.detail: No hook on the first frame (the chip came at 3.5 s) and a reveal line hidden behind Rohan. Fixed with a chip at start carrying the interest jump and by dropping the actor in that beat; re-rendered once.

findings.title: The tenure stretch was shown with the emi kind
findings.detail: With no loan_prepay maths kind, the stretched loan is emi at 8.65% over 27 years (₹47,926, about the old ₹47,910); the exact stretch is 324.4 months. The end card says tenure is rounded to whole months.

findings.title: check-plan wants #Shorts on long videos
findings.detail: The only check-plan failure; the plan ships without #Shorts on purpose. Logged in the long-form backlog as a code bug.

findings.title: Release upload is not allowed from cloud sessions
findings.detail: `ship --release` got HTTP 403; shipped via the media/L-20261018-01 branch instead (release-video.yml turns it into Release video-L-20261018-01).

changes.title: Video L-20261018-01 committed to main
changes.detail: Manifest, script, thumbnail and preview on main; the mp4 is on branch media/L-20261018-01 for the release workflow.

changes.title: Three backlog items
changes.detail: check-plan #Shorts bug, reveal text under an actor, and the first-frame hook rule.
